body.statement: Let \(p=2\), let the true common order be \((1,2)\), and consider calibrated views \(a,b\) with the same nonzero structural edge coefficient and equal positive within-view disturbance variances variable by variable. The reverse order \((2,1)\) is compatible if and only if \(\rho_1^{ab}=\rho_2^{ab}\). Hence unequal disturbance correlations reject the reverse order, while equal correlations reproduce the homogeneous two-view Gaussian ambiguity.
body.justification: The reduction is a falsifiable sanity check and identifies the exact equality boundary in the smallest system.
body.gap: HeurtebiseEtAl2026LiMVAM supplies a diversity condition for recovery but not this pointwise reverse-order equivalence calculation under partial calibration.
body.consumer: The formula gives practitioners a transparent diagnostic for whether two calibrated views contain any directional information.
